_common: The images show the same tiny low-resolution character from a 1996 isometric cyberpunk game, image[1] from the front, image[2] three-quarter front, image[3] from its right side. Redraw this character as one clean, detailed, high-resolution full-body character reference: a single figure seen straight from the front, standing in a relaxed A-pose (arms straight and slightly away from the body, legs straight, feet apart), neutral even lighting, plain white background, no shadow, no text, whole figure visible head to toe. Keep exactly the outfit, colours, materials, silhouette and proportions of the reference; gritty 1990s cyberpunk style, realistic materials, game-ready 3D character reference. Character:
agent: a modernised cyberpunk syndicate cyborg agent, gritty and menacing. Key features: a long black coat reaching the ankles, matte black heavy fabric with subtle quilted horizontal padding across the chest, a tall straight upright stand collar (not folded, no lapels) rising up to the ears; a utility belt with pouches and a metal buckle worn over the coat at the waist; a black fitted mask covering the nose, mouth and chin; blank glowing pale white eyes with no pupils; natural realistic human skin, slightly pale; short dark hair, neatly cut short on the sides; brushed-steel cybernetic shoulder pads, compact, with a few small vents; dark blue-black armoured cybernetic plating on the forearms and boots, with subtle blue glowing seams; black tactical gloves; heavy armoured boots. Stern, emotionless, high-tech corporate assassin, Blade Runner style, no weapon in hand.
police: a modernised, realistic cyberpunk riot police officer of the corporate state: a long dark violet-purple armoured coat-tunic reaching the shins over grey ballistic body armour, a closed pale grey metallic helmet with a dark visor covering the whole head, grey metallic shoulder and forearm armour plates, grey tactical gloves, black armoured boots. Disciplined, menacing. No weapon.
briefcase_m: a modernised, realistic cyberpunk corporate businessman: short slicked blond hair, a slate grey-blue tailored jacket with darker horizontal bands across the chest, a dark red belt, dark grey trousers, black shoes, a brown leather briefcase in his right hand, a small cybernetic earpiece.
_ref_note: image[4] is the original box art of this agent: follow its coat, collar, belt and mask, but keep the pose, view and the other features described here.
zealot: an agent of the Church of the New Epoch, a cyberpunk religious order, realistic and menacing, same gritty cyberpunk style as a modern game character render (not a cartoon). Silhouette: a tall near-rectangle, as wide at the top as at the bottom. Two huge deep burgundy mechanical half-sphere shoulder domes raised to head height, together about twice the shoulder width, smooth armour with fine panel lines and small vents, no spikes. Between them a closed smooth polished gold dome helmet, no face, framed by a tall burgundy armoured hood rising behind and above it. Two separate long white fabric drapes hang from under each dome straight to the floor like curtains on both sides; no single cape. Between the drapes a long burgundy robe to the feet, gold ornamental band down the front, black sash belt. Burgundy mechanical arms with dark joints, held slightly away from the body just in front of the drapes. No weapon.
_ref_note_zealot: image[4] is fan art: follow the hooded red figure in its middle (shoulder domes, drapes, robe), but with a closed helmet; ignore the other characters.
mercenary: a modernised, realistic cyberpunk mercenary soldier: muscular, bare powerful arms with cybernetic implants at the shoulders, a black tactical vest over a dark olive camouflage shirt, dark olive-and-black camouflage cargo trousers, a dark green beret, combat boots. Hard, battle-scarred face. No weapon.
scientist: a modernised, realistic cyberpunk corporate scientist: a long clean white lab coat reaching below the knees, open over a dark purple-navy high-collar suit, dark trousers and shoes, short ginger-blond hair, augmented-reality glasses, a data tablet clipped to the coat. Thin, intellectual. No weapon.
high_priest: a modernised, realistic cyberpunk High Priest of the Church of the New Epoch: two huge polished gold mechanical half-sphere shoulder domes raised to head height, a closed gold dome helmet framed by a tall dark armoured hood, a long gold-and-ochre ceremonial robe down the middle to the feet with a dark sash, long dark slate-blue heavy fabric drapes hanging from under the domes to the floor on both sides, gold mechanical arms. Ritual, imposing. No weapon.
shady_m: a modernised, realistic cyberpunk shady street dealer: a long dark purple-black leather trench coat reaching the shins, a wide-brimmed black hat pulled low over his eyes, a high collar hiding the lower face, dark gloves, black trousers and boots, faint purple neon trim on the coat. Secretive, dangerous. No weapon.
leth_jackt_m: a modernised, realistic cyberpunk street thug: a bulky worn brown-grey leather jacket with heavy padded shoulders, a dark t-shirt, faded blue-grey jeans, red leather boots, shaved head with a cybernetic implant, broad and heavy build. No weapon.
punk_m: a modernised, realistic cyberpunk male street punk: a tall swept spiky electric-blue and violet mohawk, a dark purple sleeveless vest with red spiked shoulder pads, grey-skinned bare arms with tattoos, black trousers with green-striped leg wraps and red bands at the knees, heavy black boots. Aggressive. No weapon.
punk_f: a modernised, realistic cyberpunk female street punk: long bright red hair in a high ponytail, a cropped white-and-black top with red stripes, black studded micro shorts over fishnet tights, black knee-high boots, pale skin, cybernetic arm implant. Lean, defiant. No weapon.
white_brun_f: a modernised, realistic cyberpunk civilian woman: short dark brunette bob haircut, a white cropped blouse, a dark red mini skirt, bare legs, simple flat shoes, small cybernetic earring. Ordinary city dweller. No weapon.
whit_blond_f: a modernised, realistic cyberpunk civilian woman: voluminous blond hair, a white cropped top, a purple mini skirt, bare legs, simple flat shoes, small cybernetic earring. Ordinary city dweller. No weapon.
